title: automation: a flow saved active through PUT /api/v1/meta/flow is never registered with the running engine (404 until restart), unlike hooks and actions
body:
QA-source: #21720 · automation.trigger-status-contract · outside the item's clauses

Seen independently by two lanes of the 17.7 pre-release run #21720 (subject `251a7dd4`): lane L7 (the `qa-flow-status-doors` recipe) and lane L6 (`approvals.approver-resolution-matrix` scratch flows). Verifier V3 re-derived it on a fresh boot: CONFIRMED, P2.

## Reproduction (admin)

1. `POST /api/v1/packages {"manifest":{"id":"com.objectstack.qa.automation","name":"QA","version":"1.0.0","scope":"project","type":"app"},"enableOnInstall":true}` → 201.
2. `PUT /api/v1/meta/flow/qa_meta_flow?package=com.objectstack.qa.automation` with a minimal start → end flow → 200 "Saved flow 'qa_meta_flow' (env-wide, state=active) [seq=1]"; `GET /api/v1/meta/flow/qa_meta_flow` returns it.
3. `GET /api/v1/automation/qa_meta_flow` → **404 "Flow not found"**; `POST /api/v1/automation/qa_meta_flow/trigger` → 404; a record trigger never fires.
4. `POST /api/v1/meta/publish-drafts` → `nothing_to_publish`; the per-item publish → 404 `NO_DRAFT`. Same without `?package`.
5. Restart on the same DB → the flow GETs 200 and triggers successfully.

`PUT /api/v1/automation/qa_meta_flow` with the same body registers immediately.

## Mechanism

- The engine registers flows only at boot, at `kernel:ready` and on `metadata:reloaded` (`packages/services/service-automation/src/plugin.ts:1371`).
- `metadata:reloaded` is announced only by publish-drafts, the per-item publish and the dev artifact watcher (`packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts:356,395`).
- A direct active save raises `onMetadataMutation`; ObjectQL's handler rebinds hooks and actions on it but not flows (`objectql/src/plugin.ts:328-352`), and service-automation does not subscribe to it.

## Why it is a defect

#10219's own comment (`objectql/src/plugin.ts:363-374`) calls a flow that is "`state='active'` and completely inert until the kernel was rebuilt" a defect; it was fixed only for the publish doors. Hooks and actions saved active through the same door go live. No doc says the metadata door does not arm flows (`content/docs/references/api/automation-api.mdx:31-32` names `PUT /automation/:name` as one way to arm a flow).

## Done when

An active `PUT /meta/flow` save arms (or re-arms) the flow on the running engine, or the save is refused / answered with an explicit "not armed until publish/restart" — and a pin covers it.
